description: Environmental Occurrences and Spills is a dataset listed in Ontario open data catalogue, an open data portal, published or maintained by Environment, Conservation and Parks. This dataset consists of information from reports received by the Spills Action Centre (SAC). They are generated and completed by SAC following the initial report of a spill. The data includes: the reference number assigned to the spill the municipality in which the spill occurred what was impacted (e.g. Coverage: Ontario. The portal files it under the publisher Environment, Conservation and Parks. Its tags are Environment and Natural Resources, Environment and energy, Environnement et richesses naturelles, Environnement et énergie. It offers 7 resource(s) in CSV, PDF, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-07-27 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence – Ontario. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ontario-portal.
